editorial.blurb: Kit Kat Club is Chicago's electric supper club where drag performances, creative cocktails, and surprisingly delicious American fare create an unforgettable night of joy and celebration.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation early and arrive for dinner before the show starts—the brunch shows are particularly popular, and you'll want time to enjoy the food and soak in the inclusive, vibrant atmosphere.

topDishes.note: fried chicken thighs perfectly cooked and tender, massive cheesy drop biscuit with sausage gravy, sunny side up eggs
over easy eggs, bacon, sausage links, toasted sourdough with jam, cheesy grits
